betelnut.name: Betel Nut
betelnut.description: Harvested fruit of the betel palm. Refreshing and invigorating when chewed.
betelnut_seeds.name: Betel Nut Sapling
betelnut_seeds.description: Plant in summer or autumn. Takes 8 days to mature, and continues to produce betel nuts after harvest.
premium_betelnut.name: Premium Betel Nut
premium_betelnut.description: Carefully dried and packaged premium betel nut. Extremely strong and invigorating when consumed.
tobacco.name: Fresh Tobacco
tobacco.description: Freshly harvested tobacco leaves with a distinctive aroma.
tobacco_seeds.name: Tobacco Seeds
tobacco_seeds.description: Plant in spring, summer, or fall. Takes 11 days to mature and must be harvested with a scythe.
dried_tobacco.name: Dried Tobacco
dried_tobacco.description: An artisan good made by curing three portions of fresh tobacco in a dehydrator.
